card.name: Words leading into 'be considered' advice
card.fires_on: Small verbs and linking words right before a recommended action is stated, such as 'should' or 'should be' before 'considered' or 'discontinued', after a dose reduction or interruption.

modes.label: Should be considered
modes.description: The word 'should' or 'be' after a dose-reduction subject, just before 'considered'.

modes.label: Dose action nouns and verbs
modes.description: A dose action word such as interruption or discontinued that completes a recommended step.
modes.example: If toxicity recurs at Grade 3, dose<< interruption>> until recovery, then resume KISQ

modes.label: Conditional 'even when'
modes.description: The word 'when' in a general-text conditional clause.
modes.example: (giving answers that were incorrect even<< when>> the group had coincided on correct answers

card.writes: It slightly favors a few odd tokens and suppresses 'false' spellings, so there is no clear link to the pattern.
card.plain: It fires on the words just before a label says a dose should be lowered, interrupted or stopped.
